mapper.select: SELECT id, policy_code, challenge_ttl_seconds, resend_interval_seconds, max_verification_attempts, mobile_hourly_limit, mobile_daily_limit, ip_hourly_limit, ip_daily_limit, device_hourly_limit, device_daily_limit, plaintext_code_retention_enabled, created_time, updated_time, version FROM public.auth_sms_runtime_policy WHERE policy_code = 'GLOBAL' AND is_deleted = false LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.auth_sms_runtime_policy ( policy_code, challenge_ttl_seconds, resend_interval_seconds, max_verification_attempts, mobile_hourly_limit, mobile_daily_limit, ip_hourly_limit, ip_daily_limit, device_hourly_limit, device_daily_limit, plaintext_code_retention_enabled ) VALUES ( 'GLOBAL', #{challengeTtlSeconds}, #{resendIntervalSeconds}, #{maxVerificationAttempts}, #{mobileHourlyLimit}, #{mobileDailyLimit}, #{ipHourlyLimit}, #{ipDailyLimit}, #{deviceHourlyLimit}, #{deviceDailyLimit}, false ) ON CONFLICT (policy_code) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE public.auth_sms_runtime_policy SET challenge_ttl_seconds = #{policy.challengeTtlSeconds}, resend_interval_seconds = #{policy.resendIntervalSeconds}, max_verification_attempts = #{policy.maxVerificationAttempts}, mobile_hourly_limit = #{policy.mobileHourlyLimit}, mobile_daily_limit = #{policy.mobileDailyLimit}, ip_hourly_limit = #{policy.ipHourlyLimit}, ip_daily_limit = #{policy.ipDailyLimit}, device_hourly_limit = #{policy.deviceHourlyLimit}, device_daily_limit = #{policy.deviceDailyLimit}, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE policy_code = 'GLOBAL' AND version = #{policy.version} AND is_deleted = false

UPDATE public.auth_sms_runtime_policy SET plaintext_code_retention_enabled = #{enabled}, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE policy_code = 'GLOBAL' AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = false
